reviewer: Codex visual review, 2026-10-25; not a human engineer or independent blinded reviewer
method: Approximate pixel references placed from full-resolution original photographs before this round's per-candidate review. Existing aggregate algorithm results and historical rough probes were already known. References are frozen before quantitative evaluation; no detector result is used as ground truth. Coordinates refer to the 1024px canonical images. Uncertainty is a judgement band, not calibrated measurement accuracy.
scope: 24 selected visible contour tasks on 11 photographs; not an exhaustive inventory of holes. Circle and ellipse tasks can intentionally address the same visible contour; do not count them as independent physical targets. All 36 photographs receive a separate output-candidate review.

excludedHistoricalProbes.label: bent bracket corner with curved transition
excludedHistoricalProbes.reason: Rounded bend has no directly visible sharp vertex; an extrapolated engineering corner would require a different task definition.

excludedHistoricalProbes.label: open decorative curl; round contour is not a hole
excludedHistoricalProbes.reason: Open spiral is not a single closed ellipse; useful negative candidate example, unsuitable as ellipse ground truth.

excludedHistoricalProbes.label: short bracket top edge
excludedHistoricalProbes.reason: Historical rough draft crosses the stem below the hook rather than the named top edge; replaced by an explicit visible housing edge.

excludedHistoricalProbes.label: reflective front cap; non-hole circle intent
excludedHistoricalProbes.reason: Cap silhouette is visibly elliptical; imposing a circle would mix tool choice with detector error. Reviewed as a non-hole candidate instead.
